parts: adv::Although the food was ready to heat, ||subj::she||pred:: transferred it to a microwavable dish because the original packaging was unsuitable.
translation: 虽然食物已经可以加热，她仍把它转移到一个适用于微波炉的盘子里，因为原包装不合适。
analysis: Although 说明食物已备好；主干是 she transferred it to a dish，microwavable 修饰 dish。because 给出换容器的原因，it 指 food。

parts: adv::If we want everyone to arrive on time, ||subj::we||pred:: ought to explain where the entrance is instead of simply sending the address.
translation: 如果希望所有人准时到达，我们应该说明入口在哪里，不能只发一个地址。
analysis: ought to 后接 explain 原形；where 从句是 explain 的宾语。instead of 是介词短语，后接 sending；整个 ought to 保持分写。

parts: adv::Before submitting her résumé, ||subj::she||pred:: asked a friend to check whether the experience she had listed was relevant to the position.
translation: 提交简历之前，她请朋友核查所列经历是否与职位相关。
analysis: Before 后接 submitting，其逻辑主语是 she；asked 后接 a friend to check。she had listed 修饰 experience，whether 从句作 check 的宾语。
